issues.reason: (Member (sk_vessels $x) full) is the exact form Categorical statements and Resultatives both bar - 'never (Member <group> <state>)' - and fullness is a property of each vessel, not of the collection as an object, so the atom is false of the sentence's content.

The half that stands is that this is precisely the circumstance the instruction set names - a state carrying its own complement per member, where the conclusion may mint Skolem-function states - but the half that falls is that a group-borne reified state is itself barred: Resultatives keeps 'the reified result state' on the group object precisely BESIDE the distributed flat half, and the per-member Skolem form is offered with 'may', not mandated.

new_gaps: Distributing a member state over a PER-BINDING SKOLEM group inside a rule conclusion has no licensed carrier: the prescribed per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $y <group>) (Member $y <state>)) cannot be emitted at top level over (sk_vessels $x) without leaving $x free, and a nested Implication inside an (And ...) is shown only for sealed complements, never for a rule conclusion.
defect_summary: The barred flat conjunct (Member (sk_vessels $x) full) must go, and the licensed replacement - the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $y <group>) (Member $y full)) - cannot range over a per-binding Skolem group from top level, so NO licensed form carries the per-vessel reading here: the conjunct can only be dropped with the loss recorded, which is filed as the new gap above.
notes: Everything else is per doctrine: the adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject as premise conjuncts, Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, GroupOf plus CardinalityPhrase "several" with no invented number, and mire_essence carrying its genus with the noun modifier unexposed.
